issues.issue: Correctly restored as the printed line (label, amount and page match, with no split). But the broad 'Local' group is not all taxes: the p2 general receipts show Property and other taxes 6,657,697, about 75% of it, and the rest is mostly charges for services. taxes (unlabeled) is a defensible dominant-category choice, but the line is mixed.

The printed label is 'Local' and inheritance tax comes only from the fund name; no printed inheritance-tax amount exists. This isn't a split, so the evidence standard doesn't strictly apply, but the statement line it sits in (receipts[0] Local 8,835,831) is now taxes (unlabeled), so taxes (unlabeled) would be consistent. The amount and budget are right.
